args.body: Check current ownership and existing receipts before fetching. Use director-checkout-terms-links.json if committed, or the original saved index, to prioritize direct fee and Canadian processor prerequisites. For an eligible package with evidence of redistribution rights, run the exact download in a clean directory and prepare the bilingual listing and activation handoff. If a required term remains unresolved, document the affected activation step and the exact evidence that would reopen it. Read back the deliverable and close under valid ownership with a lesson. Any public listing remains subject to independent review of its exact candidate.

description: The CSV baseline passed 10 of 10 offline checks after the missing module was included. That supports technical feasibility for the NLnet proposal. The saved call and funding terms are the next evidence for applicant eligibility, licensing and milestone payment. Payhip’s help index returned HTTP 200 after a separate retrieval was refused. Its direct seller documentation can clarify whether a Canadian seller can activate checkout without upfront spend. Treasury has CAD 0 available and no verified revenue. The feedback feed has five unclassified sources, so demand remains unknown.
